_what: Nothing For Sale: turning 07 off The Outskirts, a free market in a lay-by, lit by a ring of cars that pulled up nose-in and left their headlights on. Read by tools/make-nothing-for-sale.py, which writes the tables and the quotations into nothing-for-sale.html and the credits into liner-notes.html.
_tables: EVERY TABLE IS SOMETHING OF OURS THAT ITS OWN PAGE SAYS IS FREE, and make-nothing-for-sale.py refuses a table that does not point at a stimpunks.org page the Knowledge System mirror has. Each was read on 2026-09-23 for the word that makes it belong here: the courses page offers free training, the starter pack is a download, the broadsides are CC0 and made to be printed and handed out. A table with nothing on it would be the one lie a free market can tell.
_not_laid_out: TWO THINGS OF OURS ARE NOT ON A TABLE, ON PURPOSE, AND THE ROOM SAYS WHY. Our mutual aid grants have an application, eligibility limits and a waiting list, so laying them out under 'take what you need' would promise something they cannot do; they are pointed to, with that said. And our Things Library page argues for library economies without yet listing any things, so it is in the prose and not on a table.
_authors: The starter pack is David Gray-Hammond's and Helen Edgar's, named as its own page names them. The mutual aid quotation is by Sparrow, writing at Unstrange Mind: our entry links the post under the title 'A Mind Unstrange', and the site's own About page gives the author's name as Sparrow and nothing more, so nothing more is given here.
_beams: NO TWO HEADLIGHTS MATCH. Each car that pulled up has its own kind of lamp, and each beam's colour is a custom property in love.css's :root, read by the tool rather than copied here; it refuses two beams of the same colour. That mismatch is the room's argument in light: nobody brought enough on their own, and what everybody brought is different.
